distribution.narrative: Gebhardt et al. (2021) described Scolytoplatypus costatus from montane localities in Ailoshan, Jingdong, Yunnan. The source states the species is known from Yunnan above 2300 m.

host_note: The original description explicitly states Host plants: Unknown. No host is promoted.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytoplatypus costatus Gebhardt & Beaver, 2021.
